# Test-only CSL style

`ieee.csl` (IEEE, numeric) from https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles at commit
`f123868a546e6e7cec10e808ae04ef0e52bf2210`, unmodified. Licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 (see the file's `<rights>` element).
It is vendored here only so the render tests need no network. It is not part of the shipped skills.
